NAM.note: The article mentions one Tier 3 data centre and a planned government data centre but no backup site in service.

facts.fact: CRAN says Namibia's infrastructure is ready for the rollout of the Public Key Infrastructure framework, with CRAN appointed Root Certification Authority under the Electronic Transactions Act No. 4 of 2019; the rollout is still to come.

NAM.note: Nothing about civil register and ID links.
One Tier 3 data centre is mentioned without saying it rents to others, or who owns it.

facts.fact: CRAN's Elton Witbooi says the Office of the Prime Minister is leading plans to establish a dedicated government data centre.
The Electronic Transactions Act No. 4 of 2019 is the law under which CRAN has been appointed Root Certification Authority for the PKI framework.

NAM.note: No enrolment count or share is given.
Nothing about an ID number at birth.
Nothing about who operates or owns the ID system.
No register is said to be keyed on the ID number.
Nothing about the national ID system itself.
Online identity verification is only foreseen after the PKI rollout; no system checking against the national ID is stated.
A planned government data centre and one Tier 3 centre of unstated ownership; nothing for hire and nationally owned is stated.
A stakeholder engagement on the PKI is mentioned, but no one outside government is named as taking part.
